fato_historico: 2007: Cyclone Sidr hits Bangladesh, killing an estimated 5,000 people and destroying parts of the world's largest mangrove forest, the Sundarbans.
energia_do_dia: Today, your sensitive spirit may feel the weight of global currents. Like the resilience of the ancient mangroves standing tall against the storm, consider your own inner capacity for healing and renewal. It is a good time to nurture your boundaries, allowing your empathy to blossom while remaining grounded in the quiet, steady strength of your intuition.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest winds cannot shake the deep roots of a gentle soul.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual insight and the awakening of your hidden psychic potential.
conselho: Trust the ebb and flow of your emotions and prioritize your inner peace.
